mapper.insert: INSERT INTO memory_candidate (story_id, source_chapter_id, type, subject, field, value, suggested_action, evidence, processing_status, applied) VALUES (#{storyId}, #{sourceChapterId}, #{type}, #{subject}, #{field}, #{value}, #{suggestedAction}, #{evidence}, #{processingStatus}, #{applied})
mapper.select: SELECT id, story_id, source_chapter_id, type, subject, field, value, suggested_action, evidence, processing_status, applied, created_at, updated_at FROM memory_candidate WHERE story_id = #{storyId} ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT id, story_id, source_chapter_id, type, subject, field, value, suggested_action, evidence, processing_status, applied, created_at, updated_at FROM memory_candidate WHERE story_id = #{storyId} AND processing_status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT id, story_id, source_chapter_id, type, subject, field, value, suggested_action, evidence, processing_status, applied, created_at, updated_at FROM memory_candidate WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO current_state (story_id, category, subject, field, value) VALUES (#{storyId}, #{category}, #{subject}, #{field}, #{value}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE value = VALUES(value), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT id, story_id, category, subject, field, value, created_at, updated_at FROM current_state WHERE story_id = #{storyId} ORDER BY category, subject, field
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO relationship_state (story_id, subject_a, subject_b, description) VALUES (#{storyId}, #{subjectA}, #{subjectB}, #{description}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE description = VALUES(description), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT id, story_id, subject_a, subject_b, description, created_at, updated_at FROM relationship_state WHERE story_id = #{storyId} ORDER BY subject_a, subject_b
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO story_memory (story_id, type, subject, description, source_chapter_id, evidence) VALUES (#{storyId}, #{type}, #{subject}, #{description}, #{sourceChapterId}, #{evidence})
mapper.select: SELECT id, story_id, type, subject, description, source_chapter_id, evidence, created_at, updated_at FROM story_memory WHERE story_id = #{storyId} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE memory_candidate SET processing_status = 'SUPERSEDED', applied = 0 WHERE source_chapter_id = #{chapterId} AND processing_status IN ('PENDING', 'APPLIED')
